layers.name: The lavender field
stepNames: Lay the dark rows toward one point

layers.name: The balloon
stepNames: Paint the green stripes and basket

frames.label: Blend the misty sunset sky
frames.tip: Cover the whole canvas with misty blue, cool gray, and sunset gold, blended wet.

frames.label: Paint the sun
frames.tip: Paint a small round cream sun in the brightest gold, top right.

frames.label: Pull down the far trunks
frames.tip: Pull down two slate-blue misty trunks near the right edge.

frames.label: Dab the rust foliage
frames.tip: Dab loose rust patches of far autumn leaves across the misty woods.

frames.label: Paint the branch dark
frames.tip: Paint the trunk and the curved branch in dark bark brown.

frames.label: Drag bark tan along the top
frames.tip: Drag bark tan along the trunk and the top of the branch.

frames.label: Catch the sun on the bark
frames.tip: Catch the sun on the top edge of the bark with a few light strokes.

frames.label: Block in the four leaves
frames.tip: Block in the four leaves in warm rust: two at the top left, two below the branch.

frames.label: Deepen the red leaves
frames.tip: Deepen two of the leaves with leaf red.

frames.label: Brighten the gold leaves
frames.tip: Brighten the other two leaves with sunset gold.

frames.label: Block in the body
frames.tip: Block in the whole chickadee as one flat sunset-gold shape.

frames.label: Block in the wing and tail
frames.tip: Block in the gray wing and tail over the gold body.

frames.label: Paint the black cap and bib
frames.tip: Paint the black cap and the black bib.

frames.label: Paint the white cheek
frames.tip: Fill the white cheek between the cap and the bib.

frames.label: Light the chest
frames.tip: Light the chest and belly with warm white curved strokes.

frames.label: Stripe the wing feathers
frames.tip: Stripe the wing and tail with dark gray feather marks.

frames.label: Add the legs and feet
frames.tip: Paint the thin dark legs and the toes gripping the branch.
